Name: VSX Deck
Author: VSX Deck
Description: Slate VSX from the Stream Deck: ON/OFF, presets, Save and level-matched Bypass. Keys show what the live VSX applied.

Actions.Name: VSX On/Off
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle VSX. Dashed amber outline = not confirmed by a running VSX.

Actions.Name: VSX Preset
Actions.Tooltip: Load a VSX preset (green = active). Hold 1.5 s to clear. A newly added key takes the next free number, empty and ready for Save.

Actions.Name: VSX Bypass
Actions.Tooltip: VSX's own level-matched bypass (VSX keeps running). Purple = bypassed.

Actions.Name: VSX Deck App
Actions.Tooltip: Open VSX Deck: starts it, or brings its window to the front if it is already running.

Actions.Name: VSX Save
Actions.Tooltip: Save the open VSX window's settings into the selected preset.
